title: Congress Working Committee At Wardha
definition: The Wardha sessions of the Congress Working Committee (CWC) served as the strategic nerve center for the Indian National Congress during the critical transition period of 1939-1942, specifically shaping the trajectory of the Quit India Movement.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the shift from constitutional agitation to mass civil disobedience, the ideological rift between Gandhi and Bose, and the internal decision-making process of the INC during WWII.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Congress Working Committee At Wardha.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
